buttons.label: Fit
buttons.description: Optimise the free parameters of the current fit.

buttons.label: auto
buttons.description: Use every data point: the range from the first to the last.

buttons.label: Remove fit
buttons.description: Remove the current fit and close its window.

sections.label: First
sections.description: Index of the first data point the fit uses.

sections.label: Last
sections.description: Index of the last data point the fit uses.
The model's parameters. Double-click a value or bound to type it; click Fixed or Bounds to toggle. Computed outputs and linked parameters are dimmed and read only.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: The parameter's name in the model.

columns.label: Value
columns.description: The parameter's value; double-click to type a new one.

columns.label: Fixed
columns.description: A fixed parameter keeps its value when the fit runs.

columns.label: Lo
columns.description: Lower bound, used while Bounds is on.

columns.label: Hi
columns.description: Upper bound, used while Bounds is on.

columns.label: Bounds
columns.description: Keep the parameter between Lo and Hi while fitting.

columns.label: Error
columns.description: Uncertainty estimate from the last fit.
